* '''Playtest''' ([[Coruscant: Private Platform (Docking Bay) (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.”
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: Private Platform (Docking Bay)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscantprivateplatform.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Coruscant: Private Platform (Docking Bay) (Errata)]], 2 August 2019): Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform-20190802-d24ffc3.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscantprivateplatform.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the image was re-uploaded on release day turned 90° (stored as a landscape site card, Holotable commit “Flipped sites”); same picture and words. Listed as its own version under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 (18:48: every published image that differs from the previous one is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/coruscantprivateplatform.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
